text: The authors state that using unsupervised elicitation for alignment would still need humans in the loop, for example applying ICM to constitutional AI by labeling which response follows a human-specified constitution, training an unsupervised reward model and running RL. They add that humans would still need to validate whether the model interprets the constitution as intended, for example using scalable oversight techniques.
title: Humans still needed to validate unsupervised elicitation, e.g. via scalable oversight
